views.name: qualifying_raw_times
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  qualifyId,
  raceId,
  driverId,
  constructorId,
  position,
  q1 AS q1_text,
  CASE
    WHEN q1 IS NULL OR TRIM(q1) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN INSTR(q1, ':') > 0 THEN
      -- mm:ss.mmm or h:mm:ss.mmm (convert)
      (
        CAST(substr(q1, 1, INSTR(q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(substr(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 1, 
            CASE WHEN INSTR(substr(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 1), ':') > 0
                 THEN INSTR(substr(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 1), ':') - 1
                 ELSE CASE WHEN INSTR(q1, '.') > 0 THEN INSTR(q1, '.') - 1 ELSE length(q1) END
            END
          ) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(
            CASE WHEN INSTR(q1, '.') > 0 THEN
              substr(q1, INSTR(q1, '.') + 1)
            ELSE '0' END
          AS INTEGER)
      )
    WHEN q1 GLOB '*.*' THEN
      -- seconds.milliseconds like sss.mmm
      CAST(CAST(substr(q1, 1, INSTR(q1, '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(substr(q1, INSTR(q1, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS q1_ms,
  q2 AS q2_text,
  CASE
    WHEN q2 IS NULL OR TRIM(q2) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN INSTR(q2, ':') > 0 THEN
      (
        CAST(substr(q2, 1, INSTR(q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(substr(q2, INSTR(q2, ':') + 1, 
            CASE WHEN INSTR(substr(q2, INSTR(q2, ':') + 1), ':') > 0
                 THEN INSTR(substr(q2, INSTR(q2, ':') + 1), ':') - 1
                 ELSE CASE WHEN INSTR(q2, '.') > 0 THEN INSTR(q2, '.') - 1 ELSE length(q2) END
            END
          ) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(
            CASE WHEN INSTR(q2, '.') > 0 THEN
              substr(q2, INSTR(q2, '.') + 1)
            ELSE '0' END
          AS INTEGER)
      )
    WHEN q2 GLOB '*.*' THEN
      CAST(CAST(substr(q2, 1, INSTR(q2, '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(substr(q2, INSTR(q2, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS q2_ms,
  q3 AS q3_text,
  CASE
    WHEN q3 IS NULL OR TRIM(q3) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN INSTR(q3, ':') > 0 THEN
      (
        CAST(substr(q3, 1, INSTR(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(substr(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 1, 
            CASE WHEN INSTR(substr(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 1), ':') > 0
                 THEN INSTR(substr(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 1), ':') - 1
                 ELSE CASE WHEN INSTR(q3, '.') > 0 THEN INSTR(q3, '.') - 1 ELSE length(q3) END
            END
          ) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(
            CASE WHEN INSTR(q3, '.') > 0 THEN
              substr(q3, INSTR(q3, '.') + 1)
            ELSE '0' END
          AS INTEGER)
      )
    WHEN q3 GLOB '*.*' THEN
      CAST(CAST(substr(q3, 1, INSTR(q3, '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(substr(q3, INSTR(q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS q3_ms
FROM qualifying
views.description: Normalized qualifying session times per driver and race. Converts textual Q1/Q2/Q3 times (mm:ss.mmm or similar) into milliseconds where possible and exposes raw text fallback. Keeps driver/constructor/race identifiers and qualifying position.

views.body_sql:

  COUNT(*) AS entries_count,
  MIN(q.q1_text) AS min_q1,
  MIN(q.q2_text) AS min_q2,
  MIN(q.q3_text) AS min_q3,

FROM results AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId

views.description: Denormalized results joined to driver attributes and normalized numeric fastest lap speed. Useful for queries that need driver info along with result measures and lap-speed comparisons.

views.name: results_fastest_lap_speed_raw
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  r.driverId,
  r.constructorId,
  r.points,
  r.position,
  r.fastestLapSpeed AS fastestLapSpeed,
  -- try to convert textual fastestLapSpeed to numeric (km/h) where possible:
  CASE
    WHEN r.fastestLapSpeed IS NULL THEN NULL
    -- strip non-digit, non-dot, non-comma characters, replace comma with dot, then cast
    WHEN trim(r.fastestLapSpeed) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE
      CAST(
        REPLACE(
          -- remove any characters except digits, dot, comma using simple iterative replaces for common units
          REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
            r.fastestLapSpeed,
            'km/h',''),
            'kph',''),
            'kmh',''),
            'mph',''),
            's',''),
            'sec',''),
            'm/s',''),
            ' ',''),
            '\t',''),
          ',', '.'
        ) AS REAL
      )
  END AS fastestLapSpeed_num
FROM results r
grain: resultId (one row per race result row)
views.description: Raw results rows exposing fastestLapSpeed and identifying keys (one row per result). Keeps the original text value of fastestLapSpeed for questions that require the stored string, and exposes numeric conversion where possible.

views.name: driver_race_fastest_speed
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.driverId,
  r.raceId,
  r.fastestLapSpeed AS fastestLapSpeed,
  CASE
    WHEN r.fastestLapSpeed IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN trim(r.fastestLapSpeed) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN instr(r.fastestLapSpeed, 'kph') > 0 THEN
      -- remove non-digit, non-dot, non-minus characters and convert
      NULLIF(
        CAST(
          replace(
            replace(
              replace(
                replace(
                  replace(
                    replace(r.fastestLapSpeed, 'kph', ''),
                  ',', ''),
                ' ', ''),
              'km/h', ''),
            'kmh', ''),
          'KPH', '') AS REAL
        ), ''
      )
    ELSE
      -- fallback: strip commas and spaces then cast
      NULLIF(CAST(replace(replace(r.fastestLapSpeed, ',', ''), ' ', '') AS REAL), '')
  END AS fastestLapSpeed_num
FROM results AS r
grain: driverId, raceId (one row per driver per race result)
views.description: Pivoted view of a driver's fastestLapSpeed by raceId (one row per driver per race) with canonical numeric conversion and NULLs preserved. Useful for comparing speeds across races.

  drivers.surname,
  r.time AS results_time,
  CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL AND trim(r.time) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS results_time_nonempty_flag
FROM results AS r
LEFT JOIN races AS races ON races.raceId = r.raceId
LEFT JOIN drivers AS drivers ON drivers.driverId = r.driverId
grain: resultId  -- one row per results.resultId (one results record)
views.description: All result rows joined to their race and driver basic info. One row per results record, exposing race date and driver identifiers so callers can filter to a specific race date and group by driver.

views.name: driver_results_time_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  resultId,
  raceId,
  driverId,
  time AS time_raw,
  CASE WHEN time IS NOT NULL AND time != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "has_time  -- integer 1/0 indicating time_raw IS NOT NULL AND time_raw != ''"
FROM results
output_columns: has_time  -- integer 1/0 indicating time_raw IS NOT NULL AND time_raw != ''
views.description: Normalize and canonicalize time presence flag for result rows. Keeps raw time value and a boolean-like flag indicating the row has a non-null, non-empty time.

views.name: driver_race_entry_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.raceId,
  r.driverId,
  COUNT(*) AS entries_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL AND r.time != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries_with_time
FROM results r
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.driverId
views.description: Per driver per race aggregates: total entries and entries with a time. Useful to compute completion rates for drivers in any specified race or set of races.

views.name: races_core_43
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  raceId,
  name,
  date,
  time,
  year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
  CAST(strftime('%d', date) AS INTEGER) AS day,
  round,
  circuitId
FROM races
views.description: Canonical, cleaned projection of the races table exposing key identifiers and date parts (year, month, day) for filtering and grouping. Keeps original date/time and basic race/circuit attributes.

views.name: races_earliest_month_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.raceId,
  r.name,
  r.date,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM races) AS earliest_date,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', (SELECT MIN(date) FROM races)) AS INTEGER) AS earliest_year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', (SELECT MIN(date) FROM races)) AS INTEGER) AS earliest_month
FROM
  races AS r
WHERE
  -- include all races; caller can compare year/month of r.date to earliest_year/earliest_month
  r.date IS NOT NULL
views.description: Cohort of races that occur in the same year and month as the earliest race date in the races table. Does not hard-code the earliest date — returns columns needed to compute or verify the earliest year/month.

views.name: races_by_circuit_and_dateparts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.raceId AS raceId,
  r.name AS "races.name",
  r.date AS date,
  r.time AS time,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', r.date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', r.date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
  CAST(strftime('%d', r.date) AS INTEGER) AS day,
  c.circuitId AS circuitId,
  c.name AS "circuits.name AS circuit_name",
  c.location AS "circuits.location",
  c.country AS "circuits.country"
FROM races r
LEFT JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
grain: raceId  -- one row per race (with its circuit)
views.description: Denormalized view joining races to circuits with date parts extracted. Useful for queries that need race names, circuit info, and year/month/day for temporal filtering or grouping.

views.name: driver_standings_raw
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  driverStandingsId,
  raceId,
  driverId,
  points,
  position,
  wins
FROM driverStandings
views.description: Row-level driver standings entries per race; exposes driver id, race id and raw points and position fields for filtering, joining and aggregation.

views.name: drivers_dim_47
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.driverId,
  d.driverRef,
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  d.number,
  d.code,
  d.dob,
  d.nationality
FROM drivers d
views.description: Driver dimension: canonical driver identity and name fields used to present or join driver attributes.

views.name: driver_points_agg_per_driver
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ds.driverId AS driverId,
  MAX(ds.points) AS points_max,
  SUM(ds.points) AS points_sum,
  AVG(ds.points) AS points_avg,
  COUNT(ds.points) AS points_count
FROM driverStandings ds
GROUP BY ds.driverId
views.description: Aggregated points measures per driver across all driverStandings rows (exposes raw and aggregated points measures). Useful for queries needing max/total/average points per driver.

views.name: lap_times_with_driver_and_race
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  lt.raceId AS raceId,
  lt.driverId AS driverId,
  lt.lap AS lap,
  lt.milliseconds AS milliseconds,
  lt.time AS time,
  d.forename AS driver_forename,
  d.surname AS driver_surname,
  r.name AS race_name,
  r.date AS race_date,
  r.round AS race_round
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
views.description: Denormalized lap times joined to driver and race metadata to provide one row per lap time with driver and race attributes.

views.name: drivers_identity
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  driverId,
  forename AS driver_forename,
  surname AS driver_surname,
  number AS driver_number,
  code AS driver_code,
  nationality AS driver_nationality,
  dob
FROM drivers
views.description: Canonical driver identity information (stable keys and human names) for joins and display.

views.name: lap_times_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  raceId,
  driverId,
  lap,
  position,
  time,
  milliseconds
FROM lapTimes
views.description: Raw lap time records at the lap granularity with both textual and numeric time measures and links to race and driver; suitable for averaging and other aggregations.

views.name: results_with_race_and_driver
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  races.year AS race_year,
  r.driverId,
  d.surname AS driver_surname,
  r.position,
  r.positionText,
  r.points,
  r.statusId
FROM results AS r
JOIN races AS races ON races.raceId = r.raceId
LEFT JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
views.description: Denormalized result rows joined to race and driver basic info. Each row is a single result (driver in a race) with position and points plus race year for easy filtering and aggregation by season/race/driver.

views.name: driver_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  driverId AS driver_id,
  (forename || CASE WHEN forename IS NOT NULL AND surname IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END || IFNULL(surname, '')) AS full_name,
  forename,
  surname,
  nationality,
  driverRef AS driver_ref,
  dob
FROM drivers
views.description: One row per driver with canonical full name and core attributes useful for joins and reporting.

views.name: driver_standings_raw_54
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  driverStandingsId AS driver_standings_id,
  driverId AS driver_id,
  raceId AS race_id,
  points AS points,
  wins AS wins,
  position AS position,
  positionText AS position_text
FROM driverStandings
views.description: Raw driver standings rows (per race) exposing driver, race, points and wins measures for aggregation.

views.name: driver_standings_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ds.driverId AS driver_id,
  SUM(COALESCE(ds.wins,0)) AS total_wins,
  MAX(COALESCE(ds.points,0)) AS max_points,
  COUNT(ds.driverStandingsId) AS appearances
FROM driverStandings ds
GROUP BY ds.driverId
views.description: Aggregated driver-level measures from driverStandings: total wins and maximum points observed; one row per driver.

views.name: driver_age_calc
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.driverId AS driverId,
  d.forename AS forename,
  d.surname AS surname,
  d.dob AS dob,
  (CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(d.dob)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER)) AS age_years
FROM drivers d
WHERE d.dob IS NOT NULL
views.description: Driver-level relation that adds an age-in-years measure computed from dob using the current date; keeps identity and name fields to support queries asking for youngest/oldest or age-based filters.

views.name: drivers_by_nationality_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.driverId AS driverId,
  d.forename AS forename,
  d.surname AS surname,
  d.dob AS dob,
  d.nationality AS nationality
FROM drivers d
views.description: Cohort view exposing drivers filtered by nationality; useful for answering nationality-specific queries and for downstream joins or aggregations. Does not bake in a specific nationality literal.

views.name: circuits_core_58
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  circuitId,
  circuitRef,
  name AS "name as circuit_name",
  location,
  country,
  lat,
  lng,
  alt
FROM circuits
views.description: Circuit master data with identifiers, canonical name and location for joining with races or filtering by country/location.

views.name: race_with_circuit_59
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.name AS "races.name as race_name",
  races.date AS "races.date",
  races.time AS "races.time",
  races.year AS "races.year",
  races.round AS "races.round",
  circuits.circuitId AS circuitId,
  circuits.name AS "circuits.name as circuit_name",
  circuits.location AS "circuits.location",
  circuits.country AS "circuits.country"
FROM races
JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
grain: raceId (one row per race joined to its circuit)
views.description: Denormalized view joining races to their circuit rows to expose race and circuit attributes together for queries that need race name, circuit name and location or geographic/contextual filters.

views.name: results_with_driver_and_race
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  races.name AS race_name,
  races.date AS race_date,
  r.driverId,
  d.forename AS driver_forename,
  d.surname AS driver_surname,
  r.constructorId,
  r.grid,
  r.position,
  r.positionText,
  r.positionOrder,
  r.points,
  r.laps,
  r.time,
  r.milliseconds,
  r.statusId
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN races ON races.raceId = r.raceId
views.description: Denormalized race result rows joined to driver and race basic info. Useful for answering driver-level result queries (positions, points, status) with race context.

views.name: drivers_core_61
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  driverId,
  driverRef,
  forename,
  surname,
  number,
  code,
  dob,
  nationality,
  url
FROM drivers
views.description: Canonical driver table with stable identifiers and name fields for joins and filtering.

views.name: results_driver_race_measures
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  r.driverId,
  r.constructorId,
  r.number,
  r.grid,
  r.position,
  r.positionText,
  r.positionOrder,
  r.points,
  r.laps,
  r.time,
  r.milliseconds,
  r.fastestLap,
  r.rank,
  r.fastestLapTime,
  r.fastestLapSpeed,
  r.statusId
FROM results r
WHERE r.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
views.description: Denormalized results rows linking drivers and races with raw timing/measures needed for analysis (grid, position, points, milliseconds, fastest lap info, status). Useful to find best/worst performances per driver or per race.

views.name: drivers_core_63
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.driverId,
  d.driverRef,
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  d.number,
  d.code,
  d.dob,
  d.nationality,
  d.url
FROM drivers d
views.description: One-row-per-driver core identity and biographical attributes to filter or join drivers (canonical driver roster).

views.name: races_core_64
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.year AS year,
  races.round AS round,
  races.name AS name,
  races.date AS date,
  races.time AS time,
  races.circuitId AS circuitId,
  races.url AS url
FROM races
views.description: One-row-per-race identity and scheduling attributes used for chronological queries and joins to results.

views.name: results_with_driver_and_race_65
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  r.driverId,
  r.constructorId,
  r.number,
  r.grid,
  r.position,
  r.positionText,
  r.positionOrder,
  r.points,
  r.laps,
  r.time,
  r.milliseconds,
  r.fastestLap,
  r.rank,
  r.fastestLapTime,
  r.fastestLapSpeed,
  r.statusId
FROM results r
views.description: Denormalized results linking drivers to races with performance measures (points, position, time) to support questions about a driver's result in specific races.

views.name: race_with_circuit_66
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.name AS "races.name AS race_name",
  races.year AS "races.year",
  races.round AS "races.round",
  races.date AS "races.date",
  races.circuitId AS "races.circuitId",
  circuits.name AS "circuits.name AS circuit_name",
  circuits.country AS "circuits.country AS circuit_country",
  circuits.location AS "circuits.location AS circuit_location"
FROM races
LEFT JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
views.description: Denormalized races joined to their circuit attributes. Useful to compute counts or percentages of races by circuit country or location.
